name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
remarksWeb: Late Mr. Rakesh Jhunjhunwala, Promoter of the Company, held 8,28,82,958 equity shares of the Company. Following his demise on August 14, 2022, and pursuant to the Probate granted by the Honble High Court of Bombay on December 18, 2023 and approval of IRDAI vide letter dated April 06 2026, transmission of the aforesaid shares was completed on June 25, 2026.  Consequent to the above, the composition of the Promoter and Promoter Group has undergone a change, resulting in corresponding changes in the shareholding of the relevant promoter/promoter group entities as disclosed in the Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended June 30,2026 as compared to the previous quarter ended March 31,2026.   Mrs. Rekha Jhunjhunwala in her individual capacity holds 1,78,70,977 equity shares constituting 3.04% of the paid up capital of the Company.   In addition to the above, Mrs. Rekha Jhunjhunwala along with Mr. Rajeev Gupta are the designated partners of Sitara Partners LLP that holds 7,82,13,958 equity shares constituting to 13.29% of the paid up capital of the Company.  In compliance with Regulation 31A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and the No Objection letter received from NSE and BSE , Ebono Private Limited and GS E-Commerce Private Limited have been removed from the list of Promoter Group entities with effect from June 16,2026.
